title: Book 2026-08-05 — interactive reconstructions
lede: Differential Equations (Zill & Cullen) captured as 18 RGB-D keyframes. Every panel is orbitable and measurable: drag to tumble, Measure On, click two points for real inches. The AliceVision mesh is the one to measure — its scale comes from the ARKit camera track (8.2 mm mean residual). The card's printed footprint is carpet, not the book; measure the book here instead.

cards.title: AliceVision
cards.note: Real photographic texture. Includes a carpet ring — measure the book's edges, not the mesh extents.

cards.title: TRELLIS
cards.scale: labelled 831.9 x 863.6 x 82.5 mm — INHERITS the carpet-contaminated fuse footprint
cards.note: Clean isolated book shape; treat its scale label as wrong in X/Y, roughly right in thickness.

cards.title: 3DGUT — Gaussian splat
cards.note: Photoreal; orbit inside the panel. Tape measure not available in splat panels. Panel build: cropped to the subject, 380k splats, opacity floor 0.06 — orbits smoothly.

cards.title: Splatfacto (nerfstudio)
cards.note: The A/B: identical COLMAP input, nerfstudio's splatfacto trainer instead of 3DGUT. 553k gaussians trained; panel build cropped+thinned to 301k.
